turns.question: Does Juniper drinking history mean she definitely has diabetes?
turns.answer: No, drinking history by itself doesn’t mean Juniper definitely has diabetes. The notes here say she was drinking more water during a hot week, and later that her drinking seemed back to usual with no diabetes diagnosis recorded. So this history points to a past change in thirst, but it doesn’t confirm diabetes.

sections.heading: What that means
items: Increased drinking can happen for lots of reasons, including heat, diet, stress, or illness.
Diabetes is usually considered when extra drinking keeps happening or comes with other signs like more urination, weight loss, or a bigger appetite.
Because the later note says her drinking was back to usual, this doesn’t read like proof of diabetes on its own.
